input: Observed base_link XYZ patch + point-valid mask; XY centered within patch, absolute ground-relative Z retained
source_proposals: Legacy high-recall 2D geometry, freeze provider and use same provider on all splits
labels: Verified instance ownership: positive purity>=0.90 with >=5 person points; negative only if all owned points are nonperson; ambiguous ignored
sampling: Equal scene/family weights and class balance within train; repeated static frame copies excluded
selection: One candidate/seed. Select epoch and threshold maximizing whole-scene macro F1 on validation, ties lower false-positive rate then threshold closest0.5.
test_policy: After selection freeze weights/provider/calibration/preprocessing/threshold hashes; evaluate new held-out scenes+mesh families once, all failures retained
limits: This recipe does not establish deployment/generalization acceptance; report detector-level missed proposals as well as patch classification
